aberdeen.s1_head: Aberdeen's energy capital and professional core
s1loc: Aberdeen built its corporate base on the North Sea, and the energy economy still anchors the professional-services cluster around the city centre and Union Street. Law firms with deep oil, gas and energy practices, including CMS and Stronachs, sit alongside advisory and restructuring teams such as FRP Advisory. The Big Four accountancies, banks and a growing fintech and technology scene serve operators, subsea engineers and the renewables developers now driving the region's energy transition from harbour-side and out-of-town offices.

Beyond the operators, Aberdeen carries a dense workforce of engineers, financiers, lawyers and consultants, fed by the University of Aberdeen and Robert Gordon University. These are suited professionals who step into branded polos, softshells and fleeces for energy conferences, supplier away days, offshore-linked exhibitions, client site visits and sponsored community events. Office, brand and procurement managers order the kit, and they care that the logo, the colours and the embroidery match the corporate brand exactly across every team.
